beats.text: Tip-off won by the Hawks. Here we go.
Prediction opportunity before the next action.
Quick Kai misses a two-point jumper.
Jet Reyes attempts a three; Tower blocks it.
Quick Kai picks the pocket. Steal!
Dime Cho throws it away. Turnover.
Jet Reyes floats in a layup off a Dime Cho pass. First points of the night.
Quick Kai answers with a three from the wing. Foxes are on the board.
Splash Okafor drains his first three of the night!
Pike dunks it off a Quick Kai lob.
The Viking cuts to the rim for two.
Rafa curls off a screen and hits a jumper.
Splash Okafor hits another three. He is heating up.
Quick Kai finishes the fast break himself.
Tower muscles in a putback off a Quick Kai feed.
Ice Mercer hits a mid-range jumper just before the buzzer.
Doorbell Bell throws down a dunk.
Prediction opportunity before the next action.
Big Mo Adeyemi pulls down a rebound. Quiet night so far.
Splash Okafor from deep again. That is four threes!
Quick Kai hits a step-back three.
Foul on the Hawks. Foxes get a free throw.
Lefty Navarro drives left for a layup.
Frosty Frost finishes a pretty pass from Quick Kai.
The Wall tips in a putback.
Bucket Brooks pulls up for three off the bench.
Jet Reyes weaves through traffic for a layup.
Ice Mercer is cold-blooded from the corner. Three!
Splash Okafor makes it five threes. Unreal!
Tower scores inside again, thanks to Quick Kai.
Prediction opportunity before the next action.
Splash Okafor hits his sixth three of the night.
Hustle Kimura scores on a quick cut.
Foul on the Foxes. Viking heads to the line.
The Viking hits the free throw.
Quick Kai dribbles through three defenders for a layup.
Splash Okafor hits his seventh three. The crowd is on its feet.
Quick Kai strips the ball. Another steal!
Quick Kai goes the other way for two.
Doorbell Bell finishes at the rim.
Big Mo Adeyemi finally scores, a short hook.
Rafa hits a smooth pull-up jumper.
Dime Cho knocks down a three.
Ice Mercer answers with a three.
Prediction opportunity before the next action.
Jet Reyes scores to start the fourth.
Pike dunks again off a Quick Kai assist.
Big Mo Adeyemi loses the ball. Turnover.
The Wall scores on a putback.
Bucket Brooks hits a big three for the Foxes!
Jet Reyes answers with a three.
Splash Okafor drains a three. Eight on the night!
Frosty Frost scores with a layup.
Lefty Navarro cuts for a layup.
Quick Kai nails a three to put the Foxes ahead, 54-53.
The Viking puts the Hawks back in front.
Ice Mercer puts the Foxes ahead again, 56-55.
Doorbell Bell dunks to put the Hawks ahead!
